bridge.where: The kingdoms of Israel, and Nineveh on the Tigris
text: After Sulayman, his kingdom split, and many of the Children of Israel turned to idols again. Ilyas, known as Elijah, and after him Al-Yasa', known as Elisha, called them back.
Yunus, known as Jonah, is sent to a great city that rejects him. He leaves before God gives him leave, and his story becomes one about turning back to God.
